title: Launching an Interdisciplinary Cognitive Science and AI Conference at Cambridge
excerpt: As organising chair, Di Fu reflected on the inaugural Exploring Interdisciplinary Frontiers conference at Selwyn College, Cambridge, held on 9-10 May 2025 with over 120 participants from 18 countries.

zh.title: 在剑桥发起跨学科认知科学与人工智能会议
zh.excerpt: 作为组织主席，Di Fu 回顾了首届 Exploring Interdisciplinary Frontiers 会议。会议于 2025 年 5 月 9-10 日在剑桥大学塞尔文学院举行，吸引了来自 18 个国家的 120 多名参与者。
